description: Read an EXISTING design system and convert it: paste CSS custom properties (a Tailwind v4 @theme block, a shadcn :root block, plain CSS), a W3C DTCG token file, or a theme object as JSON, and get back the roles it names, the semantic roles it is missing, a WCAG contrast check on the pairs it defines, and the whole set re-emitted as CSS / Tailwind / SwiftUI / Compose / DTCG. The inverse of generate_design_tokens — use it to take a web theme to iOS or Android, to audit an inherited system, or to see what a third-party theme leaves undefined. Only NAMED tokens are read; a bare hex inside a rule carries no role and is never imported as one (use audit_design_system to count those). JavaScript configs are never evaluated.

format.description: Format to re-emit in (default 'all'). Use 'swiftui' or 'compose' to take a web theme to native.

name.description: Token set / brand name for the emitted artifacts (default 'Imported')

source.description: The token source: CSS custom properties, DTCG JSON, or a theme object as JSON. The format is detected automatically.

name: import_design_tokens
title: Import Design Tokens
